newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Acoje down 27.27 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Acoje down 27.27 pct in late trade.

text.p: Acoje Holdings Inc fell by nine centavos or 27.27 percent to 24 centavos per share in late trade on Friday on fears the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) could freeze the share and others that have recently posted gains, brokers said.

"The SEC came out with a ruling on Thursday freezing the prices of Itogon Suyoc at the same prices at which (they were) frozen Wednesday. Punters feared that this will spill over to other issues like Acoje so they started selling," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, executive vice-president at Diversified Securities Inc.
The SEC issued the freeze order on Itogon Suyoc A and B shares on Thursday after they rose by 50 percent in each of five consecutive sessions.
"Brokers were disappointed by the freeze order and this also made investors cautious on thirdliners and dampened interest on these issues," said another broker.
A total of 95.05 million Acoje shares had been traded just before the close. - Manila newsroom 632 8418939 fax 8176267
